Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS:4267-1967 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
STANDS, WASH HAND BASIN 

0. FOREWORD 

v.i This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 21 September 1967, after the draft finalized by the Hospital Equipment 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Consumer Products 
Division Council. 

0.2 The formulation of Indian Standards on hospital equipment has been 
taken up on the recommendations of the Advisory Conamittec for Develop- 
ment of Medical Instruments, Equipment and Appliances, Government of 
India. 

0.3 In this standard single and double wash hand basin stands which are 
in most use, have been covered. The portable wash hand basin stands 
which are at the moment under development, would be covered in due 
course. 

0.4 This Indian Standard forms one of a scries of Indian Standards on 
hospital furniture. Other standards published so far in the series are: 

IS : 4035-1967 Trolleys, stretcher 

IS : 4036-1967 Trolleys, patient 

IS : 4037-1967 Stretcher and stretcher carriers 

0.5 In preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from 
B,S. 3475 : 1962 'Specification for bowl stands for use in hospitals', 
published by the British Standards Institution. 

0.6 In some of the clauses of the standard, reference has been made to 
IS: 4033* and IS:4034t. Until these standards are published, the 
requirements in such clauses shall be subject to agreement between the 
concerned parties. 

0.7 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, express- 
ing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2- 1960 J. 
The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should 
be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 

♦Geaeral requirements for hospital furniture {under preparation), 
fSpecification for castors for hospital equipment ( under preparation ). 
{Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised). 



IS: 4267 -1967 

1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard specifies the requirements for single and double wash 
hand basin stands used in hospitals and other similar institutions, 

2. MATERIALS 

2.1 Framework — shall be according to 2.1 of IS : 4033*. 

2.2 Castors — shall be according to IS : 40341. 

3. SHAPES AND DIMENSIONS 

3.1 The shapes of single and double wash hand basin stands are shown in 
Fig. 1 and 2, respectively. These shall conform to the principal dimensions 
indicated thereon. The thickness of tubes used and corresponding outside 
diameters for different parts of the wash hand basin stands shall be as given 
below: 

Part Thickness of Tube Outside Dia of Tube 

mm mm 

Upright supports 1 '22 25-40 

Rings, basin supports and 1-02 12'70 

tie bars 

4. MANUFACTURE 

4.1 Framework — Wash hand basin stands shall have a framework of 
single continuous length mild steel tubes as shown in Fig. 1 and 2. Wash 
hand basin support tubes, if provided, shall be welded either to uprights 
or to the rings. Tie bars shall be welded to the uprights. Each ring shall 
comprise a tube bent into a circle and the ends smoothly welded together. 
When wash hand basin support tubes are provided, these shall be arranged 
in such a manner as to provide a stable support for a basin of the diameter 
for which the stand is designed. Either way, the top of the rim of the 
basin shall remain about 25 mm above the top of the ring. The design 
shall allow for asepetic handling and easy removal of the basin and, if 
required, for the draping of a sterile towel over the stand before the basin 
is inserted. 

4.2 Castors or Shoes — Single wash hand basin stand shall be provided 
with three castors and double wash hand basin stand with four castors 
50 mm in diameter. Rest of the details shall conform to IS : 40341. 
The castors shall swivel in ball races and shall have anti-static rubber 
tread. Alternately if so required by the purchaser, the single wash hand 
basin stand may be provided with three rubber shoes instead of castors.

4.3 Wash Hand Basins — The wash hand basins shall conform with the 
requu-ements specified for 350 mm diameter wash bowl in IS : 3994-1967*. 

5. WORKMANSHIP AND FINISH 

5-1 The workmanship and finish shall be in accordance with 5 of 
IS : 40331. 

6. MARKING 

6.1 The marking shall be as specified in 7 of IS : 40331-

7.1 The packing shall be as specified in 8 of IS : 4033t.
